shortDescription: Gets the URL Filtering and Cloud App Control settings.

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: block_skype
options.description: Indicates whether access to Skype is blocked or not.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: consider_embedded_sites
options.description: Indicates if URL filtering rules must be applied to sites that are translated using translation services or not.

options.name: enable_block_override_for_non_auth_user
options.displayName: Enable Block Override For Non Auth User
options.description: Indicates if authorized users can temporarily override block action on websites by providing their authentication information

options.name: enable_chat_gpt_prompt
options.description: Indicates if the use of generative AI prompts with ChatGPT by users should be categorized and logged

options.name: enable_cipa_compliance
options.description: Indicates if the predefined CIPA Compliance Rule is enabled or not.

options.name: enable_dynamic_content_cat
options.description: Indicates if dynamic categorization of URLs by analyzing content of uncategorized websites using AI/ML tools is enabled or not.

options.name: enable_gemini_prompt
options.description: Indicates if the use of generative AI prompts with Google Gemini by users should be categorized and logged

options.name: enable_meta_prompt
options.description: Indicates if the use of generative AI prompts with Meta AI by users should be categorized and logged

options.name: enable_microsoft_copilot_prompt
options.description: Indicates if the use of generative AI prompts with Microsoft Copilot by users should be categorized and logged

options.name: enable_msft_o365
options.description: Indicates if the Zscaler service is allowed to permit secure local breakout for Office 365 Traffic automatically without any manual configuration needed. Enabling this option turns off SSL Interception for all Office 365 destinations as per Microsoft's recommendation. If you want to continue using existing granular controls for Office 365, disable this option and enable preexisting configuration.

options.name: enable_newly_registered_domains
options.description: Indicates whether newly registered and observed domains that are identified within hours of going live are allowed or blocked

options.name: enable_office365
options.description: Enables or disables Microsoft Office 365 configuration. If you want to continue using existing granular controls for Office 365 Recommended to turn off the enableMsftO365 option and enable this option instead. This is a legacy option used for backward compatibility.

options.name: enable_perplexity_prompt
options.description: Indicates if the use of generative AI prompts with Perplexity by users should be categorized and logged

options.name: enable_poe_prompt
options.description: Indicates if the use of generative AI prompts with Poe by users should be categorized and logged

options.name: enable_ucaas_log_me_in
options.description: Indicates if the Zscaler service is allowed to automatically permit secure local breakout for GoTo traffic Without any manual configuration needed. When enabled, this option turns off SSL interception for all GoTo destinations. To continue using existing granular controls for GoTo traffic Disable this option and enable Cloud Application and Firewall Network Application policies accordingly.

options.name: enable_ucaas_ring_central
options.description: Indicates if the Zscaler service is allowed to automatically permit secure local breakout for RingCentral traffic Without any manual configuration needed. When enabled, this option turns off SSL interception for all RingCentral destinations To continue using existing granular controls for RingCentral traffic Disable this option and enable Cloud Application and Firewall Network Application policies accordingly.

options.name: enable_ucaas_talkdesk
options.description: Indicates if the Zscaler service is allowed to automatically permit secure local breakout for Talkdesk traffic With minimal or no manual configuration needed. When enabled, this option turns off SSL interception for all Talkdesk destinations To continue using existing granular controls for Talkdesk traffic Disable this option and enable Cloud Application, DNS, and Firewall Network Application policies accordingly.

options.name: enable_ucaas_webex
options.description: Indicates if the Zscaler service is allowed to automatically permit secure local breakout for Webex traffic Without any manual configuration needed. When enabled, this option turns off SSL interception for all Webex destinations To continue using existing granular controls for Webex traffic Disable this option and enable Cloud Application and Firewall Network Application policies accordingly.

options.name: enable_ucaas_zoom
options.description: Indicates if the Zscaler service is allowed to automatically permit secure local breakout for Zoom traffic Without any manual configuration needed. When enabled, this option turns off SSL interception for all Zoom destinations. To continue using existing granular controls for Zoom traffic Disable this option and enable Cloud Application and Firewall Network Application policies accordingly.

options.name: enforce_safe_search
options.description: Indicates whether only safe content must be returned for web, image, and video search. Safe search is supported for specific search engines and other platforms

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.
